'''Josiah Benedict''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 15th at [[March 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament]] on 24 March 2001, according to Peter Jacobson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1947">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01], DeckTech (Peter "jeeps" Jacobson, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-rochester-mn-directors-report-3-24-01d1947/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
